# The rounds of the run end while the request is still pending. The run gives up: it comments on the item, holds it and finishes.
# The loop of the run holds one round here (the replace on policy.star), and a sign-off from one member ends that round at once.
# The comment names the step that starts the item again after a finished run: beehest run, not beehest resume.
[!exec:jq] skip
[!exec:ssh-keygen] skip
[!exec:sqlite3] skip
[!exec:flock] skip
[!exec:git] skip
[!exec:sha256sum] [!exec:shasum] skip
isolate
! exec bd version
! exec gh version

approvalsinit
approvalsfakes
approvalskeys ann sam pat
subst home/.approval/config
env HOME=$WORK/home
env APPROVALS_DIR=$WORK/ops
env APPROVALS_WINDOW_SECONDS=300
env APPROVAL_POLL=1
replace ops/policy.star 'ROUNDS = 400' 'ROUNDS = 1'

exec sh ops/scripts/submit.sh msa msa.md ann
exec beehestreal item add approvals req-1 --title 'Release' --body-file body.txt
exec beehestreal run req-1 approvals --workflow ops/workflow.star &
waitfile notices.log
exec signoff sam security approve req-1 msa
wait
stdout 'item req-1 finished'

exec sqlite3 state/local.db 'SELECT state FROM items WHERE id = "req-1"'
stdout '^hold$'
exec sqlite3 state/local.db 'SELECT text FROM comments WHERE item = "req-1"'
stdout '^The rounds ran out before the request ended\. Run beehest run req-1 to wait again\.$'
! stdout 'beehest resume'

# The run is done, so a resume has nothing to reopen. The step that the comment names starts a new run, which reads the same request.
exec beehestreal status
stdout 'item-req-1-r1\tdone'
! exec beehestreal resume req-1
stderr 'only a cancelled or failed run resumes'
exec signoff pat product approve req-1 msa
exec beehestreal run req-1 approvals --workflow ops/workflow.star
stdout 'item req-1 finished'
stderr 'run item-req-1-r2 '
exec sqlite3 state/local.db 'SELECT state FROM items WHERE id = "req-1"'
stdout '^closed$'

-- body.txt --
{"doc":"msa","kind":"release","author":"ann"}
-- msa.md --
The release candidate.
-- home/.approval/config --
NOTIFY_API=http://notify.test
-- home/.approval/credential.header --
Authorization: Bearer TESTONLY
